chart.title: Sex ratio at birth
chart.subtitle: Number of boys born per 100 girls. Values above 100 mean more boys are born than girls. The biologically expected ratio at birth is around 105.

Sex ratio - Sex: all - Age: 0 - Variant:.titleLong: Sex ratio at birth - UN WPP
Sex ratio - Sex: all - Age: 0 - Variant:.descriptionShort: Number of male births per 100 female births.
Sex ratio - Sex: all - Age: 0 - Variant:.descriptionKey:
- On average, about 105 boys are born for every 100 girls.
- Persistent values well above 105 usually indicate sex-selective practices, since the biological ratio at birth is consistent across populations.
Sex ratio - Sex: all - Age: 0 - Variant:.descriptionProcessing: We compute this from the UN's population by sex and single year of age, as males divided by females, multiplied by 100.
